{{Top|leg}}
'''Poloda Place''' was an apartment building on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that was known as an artists' colony due to the fact that people such as award-winning author [[Kai Konnik]], famous [[Fondorian]] composer [[Metrisse]], and [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] dancer [[Nar Chan]] lived there.

Shortly after solving the case of [[Light sculptor]] [[Ves Volette]]'s murder, former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jax Pavan]] and his group resided there for a short while before being discovered by the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]].
